'''''Furcraea andina''''' is a species of flowering plant in the family [[Asparagaceae]]. It is native to Ecuador, Peru and Bolivia in South America.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Furcraea andina Trel. {{!}} Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science|url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:106421-2|website=Plants of the World Online|access-date=2020-05-11}}</ref> The fibres in its leaves, known as [[fique]], are used in making ropes.
